title: rtl-buddy design graph graph.json v1
description: Locked schema for the design tier of the rtl-buddy knowledge graph (rtl-buddy-view#126, epic rtl_buddy#375). Producer is rtl-buddy-view's `graph` verb. The envelope is NetworkX node-link JSON so `graphify merge-graphs` / `graphify query` and `networkx.node_link_graph(data, edges="links")` accept the file as-is. Other tiers (config: rtl_buddy#376, binding: rtl_buddy#378) emit the same envelope with their own node/edge vocabulary; merging is a node-id union, so identical ids across tiers are deliberate stitch points.

directed.description: Always true — every relation in the vocabulary is directional.

multigraph.description: Always true — parallel edges are normal (a module instantiating the same child twice, an instance overriding several parameters).

graph.description: Graph-level attributes: schema version, generator provenance, and where node file paths are anchored.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. 1 today; a bump means the node/edge vocabulary changed incompatibly.

tier.description: Which tier of the graph this file carries. rtl-buddy-view emits 'design'.

project_root_rel.description: Path of the design project root relative to the directory holding this file. Node `file` paths resolve as dirname(graph.json)/project_root_rel/<file>. '.' when the graph was streamed to stdout (no anchor).

design.description: Which elaboration this graph is of. Descriptive: consumers key on node ids, not on these.

top.description: Module the export was rooted at (the TB top when --tb-top was used).

dut_top.description: Module supplied via --top; null when only --tb-top was passed.

tb_top.description: Module supplied via --tb-top; null for a DUT-rooted export.

frontend.description: Parser frontend that produced the module table ('verible' | 'slang').

nodes.description: All design entities reachable from the root, sorted by id. The id prefix encodes the type, so the sort groups by kind.

links.description: Typed relations, sorted by (source, target, type, payload).

id.description: Stable identity: module:<name> | inst:<top>/<instance path> | port:<owner>.<port> | param:<owner>.<name> | iface:<name> | modport:<iface>.<name> | dpi:<c_symbol>.

type.description: Design-tier node kinds. Other tiers add their own values.

label.description: Short human-readable name — the bare entity name, not the id.

tier.description: Tier that emitted the node; 'design' for everything in this file.

file.description: Source file, relative to the project root (absolute when the file lies outside it). Null when the entity has no source anchor (blackbox).

line.description: 1-indexed line of the declaration / instantiation. Null when unknown.

is_blackbox.description: Module / instance / interface / modport nodes: the definition was not in the filelist.

is_interface.description: Instance nodes: the instantiated name is a SystemVerilog interface, not a module.

is_top.description: Instance nodes: this is the root of the export (no instantiation site).

instance_path.description: Instance nodes: dot-separated hub-resolver path including the top segment — the same string view.json uses as nodes[].id.

instance_name.description: Instance nodes: source-level instance name; null at the root.

module.description: Instance nodes: name of the instantiated module or interface.

depth.description: Instance nodes: hierarchy depth, 0 at the root.

owner.description: Port / parameter nodes: the module or interface that declares them (or, for a node recovered from a binding site, that the binding names).

dir.description: Port nodes: input | output | inout, or null when unknown (blackbox / interface bundle).

width.description: Port nodes: bit width when it is a literal packed range, or 1 for a bare scalar keyword (logic/wire/reg/bit, optionally signed/unsigned). Null when parameterized, when the type is anything else (int/byte/chandle, a typedef, a package-scoped struct), or when port_kind is not 'wire'. Never evaluated and never type-resolved — a wrong width is worse than a missing one.

type_text.description: Port nodes: verbatim source slice of the declared type.

port_kind.description: Port nodes: scalar wire, interface bundle, or a flattened per-signal port.

interface_type.description: Port nodes: interface name for interface ports.

modport.description: Port nodes: modport name pinned by the port declaration.

default.description: Parameter nodes: verbatim default-value expression; null for a blackbox's inferred parameter.

doc.description: Module nodes: leading documentation comment, when the frontend captured one.

signals.description: Interface nodes: names of the signals declared in the interface body.

interface.description: Modport nodes: the owning interface name.

inputs.description: Modport nodes: signals the modport declares as inputs.

outputs.description: Modport nodes: signals the modport declares as outputs.

inouts.description: Modport nodes: signals the modport declares as inouts.

sv_name.description: dpi_function nodes: the SystemVerilog-side function/task name.

c_symbol.description: dpi_function nodes: the C linkage symbol — the alias in the `import "DPI-C" c_name = function ...` form, else the SV name. Also the node id's suffix.

direction.description: dpi_function nodes: import (C implements, SV calls) or export (SV implements, C calls).

signature.description: dpi_function nodes: verbatim source slice of the function/task prototype, trailing ';' stripped.

source.description: Node id the relation starts at.

target.description: Node id the relation ends at.

type.description: Design-tier relations: instantiates (module→module|interface), child_of (instance→parent instance), instance_of (instance→module|interface), connects (instance→port), implements (module→modport), overrides (instance→parameter), imports_dpi / exports_dpi (module→dpi_function), calls (module→dpi_function, one edge per recovered call site — best-effort).

confidence.description: Always EXTRACTED for this tier — every relation comes from a deterministic CST walk.

instance.description: instantiates: the source-level instance name that creates the edge.

formal.description: connects: the formal port name being bound.

actual.description: connects: verbatim net expression at the parent. Empty string for the implicit `.port` shorthand.

parameter.description: overrides: the parameter name being overridden.

positional.description: connects / overrides: the binding was positional and the name was resolved from the child's declaration order.

index.description: connects / overrides: 0-based position in the instantiation's binding list.

port.description: implements: the interface port that pins the modport.

file.description: Source file of the binding site, project-relative.
